subject: POC follow-up: Nimbus Health evaluation criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@nimbushealth.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver@nimedical.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC follow-up: Nimbus Health evaluation criteria & next steps

Hi Priya / Oliver,

Thanks again for a productive call today. Appreciate the clarity on the three evaluation use-cases (patient triage, appointment summarization, and eligibility extraction). Per our discussion, I pulled together a compact POC plan below so we can align on success metrics, owners, timeline, and what data we need from your side. Please review and flag anything you'd like changed.

POC objective
- Validate Redwood inference for production latency, throughput, cost, and extraction quality on Nimbus sample traffic.

Proposed success criteria (must-haves)
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 200 ms (for 128-token prompts); p50 <= 60 ms
- Throughput: sustained 50 requests/sec with tail latency still within SLO; short burst up to 200 req/sec for traffic spikes
- Cost: average token cost <= $0.005/token during POC (including batching/quantization config)
- Quality: intent/slot extraction F1 >= 0.90 on your labeled evaluation set; summarization ROUGE-L relative improvement >= baseline by 8%
- Reliability: error rate < 0.5% (5xx or model-failure) across test window

Operational acceptance gates
- End-to-end pipeline demo with sample data and live inference within 2 business days of data delivery
- Performance runbook + perf-test results shared before pilot handoff

Timeline (draft)
- Week 0 (this week): confirm scope, NDA/procurement contacts, and data access method
- Week 1: data share + redwood sandbox access; initial smoke test (functional)
- Week 2: performance tuning and profiling; run 50 RPS baseline tests
- Week 3: quality evaluation against your labeled set + final readout
- End of Week 3: decision call (go/no-go / next steps)

Ownership
- Redwood: Rafael (sales) — overall program; Ben (solutions eng) — perf tests & tuning; Monica (CS) — onboarding/runbook
- Nimbus: Priya — product owner; Oliver — engineering lead; procurement contact TBD

Data / access ask (what we need from Nimbus)
- A representative sample of 1–2k queries per use-case (CSV preferred) — see sample_queries.csv
- Example documents for summarization (10–25 docs)
- VPN/S3 access details or secure file transfer to the shared Drive link

Attachments: nimbus_poc_scope.xlsx (scope + milestone checklist), sample_queries.csv

Next steps
1) Please confirm the success criteria above or propose edits by Tue, Jun 17
2) Share a primary procurement contact so we can loop legal/finance if needed
3) Confirm data delivery method and timing

Thanks — happy to jump back on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Priya Shah <priya@nimbushealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver@nimedical.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC follow-up: Nimbus Health evaluation criteria & next steps

Rafael — thanks for the concise plan. This is very close to what we discussed. A couple quick notes and asks: 

1) Quality targets: F1 >= 0.90 sounds ambitious but reasonable for intent/slot extraction; for summarization can we target a human-rated helpfulness score >= 4.0/5 in addition to the ROUGE target? Our product team values end-user helpfulness more than raw ROUGE.
2) Timeline: Week 3 feels tight for both perf and final quality readout. Can we extend to Week 4 for a more thorough A/B on the summarizer?
3) Procurement: Please loop in procurement@nimbushealth.com (they handle contract wording).

We can deliver the CSV of sample queries and 15 anonymized documents by EOD Thu (Jun 19). Will that work?

Thanks,
Priya
Product Lead | Nimbus Health
priya@nimbushealth.com | +1 917-555-4410

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@nimbushealth.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver@nimedical.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC follow-up: Nimbus Health evaluation criteria & next steps

Priya — thanks, that helps a lot. Confirming changes we will adopt:
- Add human helpfulness rating >= 4.0/5 for summarization as a secondary quality metric
- Move final readout to end of Week 4 to allow an A/B cycle on summarization

Updated timeline (agreed)
- Week 0: confirm scope + procurement contact (procurement@nimbushealth.com added)
- Week 1: data share + sandbox access; functional smoke tests
- Week 2: perf tuning + initial load tests (50 RPS baseline)
- Week 3: quality tuning + A/B setup for summarization
- Week 4: extended A/B, final readout, and decision call

Ben, can you confirm the perf-test plan below is sufficient? We'll run the Redwood perf plan (attached as redwood_perf_test-plan.pdf) and share results in the Week 2 summary.

On ownership: Rafael (program lead), Ben (perf/ops), Monica (onboarding), Priya (product), Oliver (eng).

If that looks good I'll set the kickoff for Jun 23 at 10am PT to hand off access and run the smoke tests.

Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC follow-up: Nimbus Health evaluation criteria & next steps

Rafael / Priya — quick note from the engineering side. Perf plan attached (redwood_perf_test-plan.pdf) includes:
- Synthetic load generator for steady-state 50 RPS and stress to 250 RPS for 10-minute windows
- Tokenization and 128-token/512-token profiles; we'll surface latency by token length buckets
- KV cache and batching configs we'll trial (quantized model profiles Q4 and Q8)

Couple of asks to make the perf runs meaningful:
- Please confirm which prompt templates we'll use for the 3 use-cases (we can use the sample_queries.csv but prefer canonical templates)
- If possible, provide a few longer documents (>= 1k tokens) to exercise cache behavior for summarization

I'll own perf runs and share a short deck with graphs and recommended configs after Week 2 tests.

Thanks everyone — this looks good. Confirming:
- We will deliver sample_queries.csv and 15 anonymized documents by Thu, Jun 19 (uploaded to the Drive link)
- Procurement contact is procurement@nimbushealth.com (copied)
- Kickoff set for Mon, Jun 23 at 10:00 AM PT (please send calendar invite)

On the quality side, product will run a quick human rating pass after Week 3 A/B and provide the helpfulness scores. If those meet the >=4.0/5 threshold and Ben's perf numbers meet the latency/throughput gates, we'll move to a small pilot in production.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Priya
